org/springframework/stereotype/Component.summary: Indicates that an annotated class is a 'component', a candidate for auto-detection when using annotation-based configuration and classpath scanning.

value.summary: The value may indicate a suggestion for a logical component name.

org/springframework/stereotype/Service#.summary: Indicates that an annotated class is a 'Service', originally defined by DDD as 'an operation offered as an interface that stands alone in the model'.

org/springframework/stereotype/Repositor.summary: Indicates that an annotated class is a 'Repository', originally defined by DDD as 'a mechanism for encapsulating storage, retrieval, and search behavior which emulates a collection of objects'.

org/springframework/context/annotation/C.summary: Indicates that a class declares one or more @Bean methods and may be processed by the Spring container to generate bean definitions and service requests for those beans at runtime.

org/springframework/context/annotation/B.summary: Indicates that a method produces a bean to be managed by the Spring container.

name.summary: The name of this bean, or if several, aliases for this bean.

org/springframework/beans/factory/annota.summary: Marks a constructor, field, setter method, or config method as to be autowired by Spring's dependency injection facilities.

required.summary: Declares whether the annotated dependency is required.

org/springframework/beans/factory/annota.summary: This annotation may be used on a field or parameter as a qualifier for candidate beans when autowiring.

org/springframework/context/annotation/P.summary: Indicates that a bean should be given preference when multiple candidates are qualified to autowire a single-valued dependency.

org/springframework/context/annotation/L.summary: Indicates whether a bean is to be lazily initialized.

notes: Bean role = type transitively meta-annotated with @Component (covers @Service/@Repository/@Configuration/@Controller chains) OR method annotated with @Bean. Bean name resolution: explicit attribute > BeanNameGenerator default (decapitalized simple class name).
